# SpikeTimingCoding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
A neural coding scheme where information is represented by the precise timing of individual spikes rather than just firing rates. Provides high temporal resolution and low-latency communication, essential for real-time belief propagation in dynamic environments.
